title: Madanolsavam
overview: Madanolsavam is a satirical tale about democracy and the struggle of Madhanan, a street hawker. After becoming the caretaker of his late friend Mohanan's family-his wife Alice and daughter Manju-he marries Alice. However, a politician with the same name drags him into a political contest, forcing him to navigate absurd politics to reclaim his identity.

songs.title: Paaravaaram Eelokam
songs.singers: Christo Xavier, Medha Mehar, Vaisakh Sugunan
